backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend defining product, order, user, and settings types, along with state variables and mixins for storage, authorization, and HTTP outcalls (Stripe, Razorpay).
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades stored orders from the old format (no guestDetails) to the new format by adding a null guestDetails field to each order.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three checkout/admin UI features (guest checkout fields, inline admin orders display, order detail modal updates) to their implementation files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key changes, serving as a build-planning reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic Skincare app, loading Playfair Display/Lato fonts, the Razorpay checkout script, and the React app entry module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with all customer routes (home, shop, product detail, cart, orders, payment) and protected admin routes (dashboard, products, orders, settings, users) with auth guard and layout wrappers.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: A section component explaining Ayurveda's philosophy, describing the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) with scroll-triggered slide-in animations for left and right content panels.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that verifies the authenticated user has admin privileges via the actor, showing loading, denied, error, or timeout states and redirecting to login if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile overlay) containing navigation links and a sign-out button, wrapping page content in a scrollable main area.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI widget that simulates AI image generation by mapping a text prompt to a curated Unsplash botanical image, with a preview and a button to apply the selected image URL.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: A dialog modal that displays full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and allows admins to update the fulfillment status via a dropdown select.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A dialog form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, specifications, and status selection.
frontend/src/components/admin/StatusBadg: A small presentational component that renders a styled badge for a product's status (Visible, Out of Stock, Launching Soon, Featured, Not Visible) with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: A read-only dialog modal that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Displays a 6-card grid of product benefits (e.g., 100% Natural, Cruelty-Free) with scroll-triggered fade-in animations and a textured background.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that lists cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the /cart page.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Fetches and displays featured products in a responsive grid with loading skeletons, filtering out non-visible products, and a link to the full shop.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation and tooltip that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-configured number with a fallback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details rendered on a dark forest-green background.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section for the Nature Glow landing page featuring a Ken Burns animated background, layered gradient overlays, animated brand name, badge, headline, and CTA buttons with mount-triggered fade-in transitions.
Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with backdrop, nav links (Home, Shop, Orders), and auth actions (Login/Logout), rendered only on small screens.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navbar with brand logo, desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, auth button, and a hamburger menu that opens the MobileNavDrawer on small screens.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component that displays product image, name, price, and status badges, and supports Add to Cart and Buy Now (Razorpay checkout) actions while hiding notVisible products.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that auto-seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Testimonials section rendering a grid of animated customer review cards with star ratings, quotes, product tags, and author avatars using IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered reveal.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: Provides a React context for managing the shopping cart state, exposing actions to add, remove, update, and clear items along with computed totals and cart drawer open/close state.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Provides a React context for shopping cart state, persisting items to sessionStorage and exposing add, remove, update, and clear operations along with totals and cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status through a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, covering products, orders, user profiles, site settings, and admin checks via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that opens a Razorpay payment checkout using the backend-provided key, clears the cart on success, and navigates to success or failure routes accordingly.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Lato), and defines CSS custom properties for both the customer storefront (Ayurvedic palette) and admin panel themes in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
Admin dashboard page that aggregates orders, products, and users into summary stat cards, a monthly revenue bar chart, a fulfillment-status pie chart, and a recent-orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that authenticates the user via Internet Identity, waits for the actor to be ready, checks or bootstraps admin status on the canister, and redirects to the admin products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page that lists all orders with search/sort/filter controls and expandable order cards that show customer details and allow updating the fulfillment status.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products management page that displays a searchable product list with status stats, and supports adding, editing, and deleting products via a form modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page that allows configuration of store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with form state synced from backend queries and save actions via mutations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin users page that lists all registered users in a searchable table filtered by name or principal, with click-to-open user detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls, a checkout form with validation, and processes payments via Razorpay, creating an order on success.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details and initiates a Stripe checkout session, redirecting the user to Stripe's hosted payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing the landing experience with a hero section, featured/seed products, benefits, testimonials, and an Ayurveda info section.
frontend/src/pages/Orders.tsx: Orders page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's order history with payment/fulfillment status badges and product details.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful payment, offering buttons to retry (go to cart) or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that invalidates the orders cache on mount and shows confirmation UI with links to view orders or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single product by ID, displays its info, and supports add-to-cart and buy-now flows via Razorpay.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Public shop page that fetches all products and lets users filter them by search text, category, and product status (available, featured, out of stock, etc.), then renders matching products as cards.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and converting nanosecond BigInt timestamps to human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Defines a static array of sample Ayurvedic product data (ProductInput) used for seeding the product catalog during development.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom Ayurvedic brand color palette, admin-specific tokens, custom fonts, shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns and fade effects.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file recording the current version, architectural notes, known issues, existing implemented features, and pending new feature requests for the e-commerce order management system.
